sentences: Good morning everyone, and welcome to today's lecture.
Today we are going to talk about how machines learn from examples.
A model learns patterns from the training data it is given.
If the model memorizes the training data, it performs poorly on new data.
This problem is called overfitting, and it is very common.
One way to reduce overfitting is to collect more training data.
Another way is to keep the model simple.
Cross validation helps us estimate how well a model will generalize.
Please write down the main ideas in your notebook.
The homework for next week is to evaluate a simple classification model.
